figurative_meaning_en: Ignorant about the outside world or external affairs
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কুয়োর ব্যাঙের মতো, বাইরের কোনো খবর রাখে না।
গ্রামের লোকেরা শহরের জীবন সম্পর্কে কুয়োর ব্যাঙের মতো অজ্ঞ।
example_sentences_in_english: He is like a frog in a well, unaware of any outside news.
The villagers are ignorant about city life, just like frogs in a well.
history: This idiom originates from an ancient parable, similar to the Chinese story of the frog in the well, symbolizing limited perspective; in Bengali folklore, it illustrates someone confined to their small world, unaware of broader realities.
